changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Route yearly finance and voucher summary questions to dts-stack dbt ADS tables instead of application MySQL or L0 business-object profiles.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template (template_code, domain, role_hint, intent_patterns, question_samples, sql_template, parameters, target_view, description, priority, is_active) VALUES ('TPL-56', 'finance', NULL, '[".*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(财务|收款|回款|应收|实收).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览).*",".*(财务|收款|回款|应收|实收).*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览).*"]', '["2026年财务数据统计下","看下2026年财务数据统计","今年财务数据汇总"]', $tpl$ WITH months AS ( SELECT month_key FROM (VALUES (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-01'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-02'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-03'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-04'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-05'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-06'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-07'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-08'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-09'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-10'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-11'), (CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-12') ) AS v(month_key) ), settlement AS ( SELECT s."业务月份" AS finance_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s."项目") AS settlement_project_count, SUM(s."结算单数") AS settlement_record_count, ROUND(SUM(s."应收折前"), 2) AS receivable_before_discount, ROUND(SUM(s."折后实收"), 2) AS discounted_receivable, ROUND(SUM(s."已回款"), 2) AS paid_amount, ROUND(SUM(s."未回款"), 2) AS unpaid_amount, ROUND(AVG(s."回款进度"), 4) AS payment_progress FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_month_settlement s WHERE s."业务月份" LIKE CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-%' GROUP BY s."业务月份" ), collection AS ( SELECT c."收款月份" AS finance_month, ROUND(SUM(c."收款金额"), 2) AS collection_amount, SUM(c."收款单数") AS collection_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c."项目") AS collection_project_count FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_collection c WHERE c."收款月份" LIKE CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-%' GROUP BY c."收款月份" ) SELECT months.month_key AS "财务月份", COALESCE(s.settlement_project_count, 0) AS "结算项目数", COALESCE(s.settlement_record_count, 0) AS "结算单数", COALESCE(s.receivable_before_discount, 0) AS "应收折前", COALESCE(s.discounted_receivable, 0) AS "折后实收", COALESCE(s.paid_amount, 0) AS "已回款", COALESCE(s.unpaid_amount, 0) AS "未回款", COALESCE(s.payment_progress, 0) AS "平均回款进度", COALESCE(c.collection_amount, 0) AS "收款金额", COALESCE(c.collection_record_count, 0) AS "收款单数", COALESCE(c.collection_project_count, 0) AS "收款项目数" FROM months LEFT JOIN settlement s ON months.month_key = s.finance_month LEFT JOIN collection c ON months.month_key = c.finance_month ORDER BY months.month_key $tpl$, '{"year":{"type":"integer","required":true}}', 'public.xycyl_ads_finance_month_settlement', '年度财务数据统计', 42, true), ('TPL-57', 'finance', NULL, '[".*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(凭证|会计凭证).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览|数量|金额).*",".*(凭证|会计凭证).*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览|数量|金额).*"]', '["2026年凭证的数据统计下","看下2026年凭证数据统计","今年凭证统计"]', $tpl$ SELECT v."会计月份", v."业务类型", v."凭证状态", SUM(v."凭证数") AS "凭证数", SUM(v."分录数") AS "分录数", ROUND(SUM(v."借方金额"), 2) AS "借方金额", ROUND(SUM(v."贷方金额"), 2) AS "贷方金额", ROUND(SUM(v."借贷差额"), 2) AS "借贷差额", SUM(v."平衡凭证数") AS "平衡凭证数", SUM(v."不平衡凭证数") AS "不平衡凭证数", CASE WHEN ABS(SUM(v."借贷差额")) < 0.005 THEN '平衡' ELSE '不平衡' END AS "借贷平衡" FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_voucher_monthly v WHERE v."会计月份" LIKE CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-%' GROUP BY v."会计月份", v."业务类型", v."凭证状态" ORDER BY v."会计月份", v."业务类型", v."凭证状态" $tpl$, '{"year":{"type":"integer","required":true}}', 'public.xycyl_ads_finance_voucher_monthly', '年度凭证数据统计', 45, true) ON CONFLICT (template_code) DO UPDATE SET domain = EXCLUDED.domain, role_hint = EXCLUDED.role_hint, intent_patterns = EXCLUDED.intent_patterns, question_samples = EXCLUDED.question_samples, sql_template = EXCLUDED.sql_template, parameters = EXCLUDED.parameters, target_view = EXCLUDED.target_view, description = EXCLUDED.description, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = now();
